title: Nightingale of the Lyrebirds
alt: Digital art portrait of a fantasy character, a changeling. They have long, white hair tied into a thick braid and pale, white skin. Their left eye is blind, surrounded by frostbite scars. Their right eye is bright blue. They're wearing a white blouse and a leather vest, as well as a black, round pendant and a peacock-feather-shaped brooch and golden earrings. Their expression is happy and open.

title: Pelleas Thelen
alt: Digital art portrait of a fantasy character, an elf boy. He has long, blonde hair, tied up into a bun, light brown skin and green eyes. He has a pale birthmark on his left cheek. His ears are long and pointed. He's sitting on a big, cushioned throne with one leg swung over the armrest. He is wearing a black turtleneck, a decorated and well-fitting green vest, fitting green pants and leather calf-high boots. His exposed arms are very muscular.

title: Misery

title: Ivellias Nailo
